ai_disclosure.summary: Check the module-specific declaration template and acknowledge GenAI when required.

coursework.summary: Use GenAI for learning support only within module instructions; do not submit AI-authored material as your own.

exams.summary: The 2026–27 conduct rules address unauthorised AI-generated or altered academic work. Check the instructions for your specific exam; no general AI permission follows.

privacy_data_entry.summary: The Library asks you to check whether inputs become training data and whether you hold the necessary copyright. Tool-specific retention and upload permissions remain unconfirmed.

academic_integrity.summary: Unauthorised AI-generated or altered academic work may breach the academic conduct regulations.

approved_tools.summary: The University guidance mentions Copilot access through Microsoft 365, not blanket assessment approval.

teaching_guidance.summary: Module staff determine permitted uses and may request a declaration.

research_guidance.summary: AI research involving human participants or their data falls within research ethics policy. Researchers must not use AI to support peer review without explicit permission.

security_procurement.summary: No independently verified institutional GenAI procurement approval or tool-specific retention controls are established here.
